summary: tiny-voca, a 4.5M-parameter model, speaks American English at 24 kHz in two voices, a woman and a man, dozens of times faster than real time on a CPU. Numbers, dates, times and money are read out as words. The model is part of the add-on: nothing to download. No voice cloning.

fields.label: Speed
fields.help: The pace of the voices. 1.0 is the model's own; a speaker's Rate in Subtitld scales it further.

fields.label: CPU threads
fields.help: 0 uses up to four threads, which is plenty for a model this small.
